subject: general
question: In March 2025, India launched 'Operation Brahma' in response to which event?

options.text: A major flood in northeastern India
A cyclone affecting the eastern coast of India
A volcanic eruption in the Andaman Islands

solution:
The correct answer is __**A devastating earthquake in Myanmar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Operation Brahma** was launched by India in March 2025 as a humanitarian mission to assist Myanmar following a **devastating earthquake.**
 
• The earthquake caused widespread destruction in Myanmar, impacting thousands of lives and infrastructure.
 
• India, under its **"Neighbourhood First Policy,"** swiftly responded with relief efforts, showcasing its commitment to regional cooperation and disaster management.
 
• The operation included the deployment of rescue teams, medical aid, and essential supplies to assist affected communities.
 
• India’s National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) and other agencies played a critical role in the success of Operation Brahma.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neighbourhood First Policy:**

 
 
• India’s foreign policy framework that prioritizes relations with neighboring countries to enhance regional cooperation and development.
 
• Emphasizes economic integration, cultural ties, and mutual assistance in times of need.
 
 
 
• **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF):**
 
 
• A specialized force in India established for disaster management under the Disaster Management Act, 2005.
 
• Equipped and trained to handle natural and man-made disasters, including earthquakes, floods, and industrial accidents.
 
 
 
• **India-Myanmar Relations:**
 
 
• India and Myanmar share a 1,643 km-long border and have strong cultural, historical, and economic ties.
 
• India has consistently supported Myanmar during crises, strengthening bilateral relations.
 
 
 
• **Earthquake Preparedness:**
 
 
• Measures include building earthquake-resistant infrastructure, conducting regular disaster preparedness drills, and promoting public awareness.
 
• India’s efforts in assisting Myanmar highlight the importance of international cooperation in disaster management.
